tools.description: Every tracked coin in one table: spot price, the overall Buy/Sell/Hold call with score and confidence, the 1 hour window, and the daily regime call (long or flat).

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: The blended reading of one coin's window over the last hours (up to 48), thinned to about 36 rows: time, up probability, score and confidence.

tools.name: list_coins_and_venues
tools.description: Which coins have venue readings, the windows, and each venue with its type and how many coins it covers.

tools.description: The latest crypto headlines from CoinArticle, newest first, each with the live overall Buy/Sell/Hold call of every tracked coin it names. Pass coin to keep only headlines that name it.
